ict.name: Islamabad Capital Territory
ict.intro: Islamabad is the planned federal capital at the foot of the Margalla Hills. It is not a province, but it is treated here as its own unit so readers can open every sector, village and institution from one page.

districts.name: Islamabad
districts.about: Islamabad was designed in the 1960s as a planned garden capital at the foot of the Margalla Hills. The Faisal Mosque, Daman-e-Koh viewpoint, Saidpur Village and Bari Imam shrine sit alongside the government sector belt and a ring of fast-growing housing societies.
districts.education: Quaid-i-Azam University, NUST, COMSATS, IIUI and NUML anchor the city's large federal college and school network.
districts.health: The Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) and Polyclinic are the main public hospitals, backed by several private teaching hospitals.
districts.culture: People from every province live here, and hiking the Margalla trails or browsing the weekly bazaars are part of everyday life.
districts.issues: Traffic congestion, unplanned housing at the city's edges, and pressure on the Margalla Hills National Park are the main ongoing concerns.
districts.villages: Saidpur, Bari Imam, Shah Allah Ditta, Golra Sharif

punjab.name: Punjab
punjab.intro: Punjab is Pakistan’s most populous province. Canal colonies, old walled cities and new industrial towns sit on the same map. Open any district card to read headquarters, schools, hospitals and local notes.

districts.name: Attock
districts.about: North-western Punjab on the Indus. Attock Fort looks over the river crossing toward KP.
districts.education: Public degree colleges in Attock, Fateh Jang and Pindi Gheb; campuses linked to University of the Punjab and AIOU.
districts.health: DHQ Attock and THQ hospitals in tehsils.
districts.culture: Potohari and Punjabi speech, river-side shrines and wheat-oilseed farms.
districts.issues: River erosion in places and the need to expand technical training.
districts.villages: Hassanabdal, Fateh Jang rural union councils

districts.name: Bahawalnagar
districts.about: South-eastern Punjab on the Indian border, once part of Bahawalpur State.
districts.education: Government colleges in Bahawalnagar, Chishtian and Haroonabad.
districts.culture: Cholistan fringe, Sufi shrines and cotton-wheat belt.
districts.issues: Border-area water and school access in some tehsils.

districts.name: Bahawalpur
districts.about: Former princely state. Palaces, the Noor Mahal area and the gateway to Cholistan Desert.
districts.education: Islamia University of Bahawalpur and a large college network.
districts.culture: Saraiki language, desert crafts and the Sadiqgarh heritage.
districts.issues: Desert water, summer heat and spreading the university’s reach into tehsils.

districts.name: Bhakkar
districts.about: Thal desert district on the left bank of the Indus.
districts.education: Government postgraduate college and degree colleges in tehsils.
districts.culture: Thal pastoral life and Saraiki speech.
districts.issues: Sand-soil farming and longer travel to specialist hospitals.

districts.name: Chakwal
districts.about: Salt Range and Potohar plateau. Many families have a long military tradition.
districts.education: Public colleges; campuses serving Choa Saidan Shah and Talagang used to sit in this belt.
districts.issues: Water table and youth employment beyond army recruitment.
districts.villages: Kallar Kahar countryside, Choa Saidan Shah

districts.name: Chiniot
districts.about: Famous for wood carving and furniture on the Chenab.
districts.education: Government colleges in Chiniot and Lalian.
districts.culture: Craftsmen’s bazaars and Umer Hayat Mahal heritage.
districts.issues: Craft industry needs design and export training.

districts.name: Dera Ghazi Khan
districts.about: Gateway between southern Punjab and the Sulaiman mountains.
districts.education: Ghazi University and medical college; public colleges in tehsils.
districts.health: DHQ and teaching hospital D.G. Khan.
districts.culture: Saraiki and Baloch tribal neighbourhoods, foot-hills culture.
districts.issues: Floods on hill torrents and access into tribal tehsils.
districts.villages: Taunsa belt (now partly a separate district), Fort Munro road villages

districts.name: Faisalabad
districts.about: Textile capital of Pakistan, laid out as Lyallpur in British canal-colony years.
districts.education: Agriculture University, Government College University Faisalabad, NTU.
districts.culture: Punjabi industry-town life and a huge mandi.
districts.issues: Air quality, factory labour conditions and urban crowding.

districts.name: Gujranwala
districts.about: Industrial city of Punjab’s north-east, known for electrical goods and food.
districts.education: University of the Punjab Gujranwala campus and many colleges.
districts.culture: Punjabi business culture and wrestlers’ tradition.

districts.name: Gujrat
districts.about: Chenab district known for furniture, ceramics and overseas workers.
districts.education: University of Gujrat and a dense college belt.
districts.health: Aziz Bhatti Shaheed Teaching Hospital / DHQ.
districts.culture: Punjabi towns of Jalalpur Jattan and Kunjah.
districts.issues: Need to keep local industry after overseas remittances.

districts.name: Hafizabad
districts.about: Rice belt of central Punjab.
districts.education: Government colleges in Hafizabad and Pindi Bhattian.
districts.issues: Rice-market prices and school quality in villages.

districts.name: Jhang
districts.about: Land of the Heer-Ranjha story, at the meeting of Chenab and Jhelum systems.
districts.education: Government colleges and a growing university presence.

districts.name: Jhelum
districts.about: Grand Trunk Road and the river Jhelum. Rohtas Fort is nearby in this historic belt.
districts.education: Cadet College Hasan Abdal is close; district colleges in Jhelum and Pind Dadan Khan.
districts.culture: Potohar military towns and salt-range villages.
districts.issues: Khewra industrial health and river-bank settlements.

districts.name: Kasur
districts.about: South of Lahore, shrine of Baba Bullhe Shah and a busy border district.
districts.education: Public colleges; many students travel to Lahore universities.
districts.culture: Punjabi kafis and leather / farm economy.
districts.issues: Industrial effluent and pressure from the Lahore mega-city.

districts.name: Khanewal
districts.about: Railway junction district in the Multan division.
districts.education: Government colleges in Khanewal, Kabirwala and Mian Channu.
districts.issues: Keeping graduates in the district instead of only Multan or Lahore.

districts.name: Khushab
districts.about: Salt Range and Soon Valley on one side, Thal on the other.
districts.education: Colleges in Jauharabad, Khushab and Naushera.
districts.culture: Soon Valley orchards and salt-range villages.
districts.issues: Water in the Soon Valley and specialist care distance.

districts.name: Lahore
districts.about: Provincial capital. Walled City, Badshahi Mosque, Lahore Fort, and Pakistan’s densest university cluster.
districts.education: University of the Punjab, UET, GCU, LUMS, UVAS, UHS and dozens of colleges.
districts.health: Mayo, Services, Jinnah, Children’s Hospital and a huge private sector.
districts.culture: Urdu and Punjabi high culture, film, food streets and urs of Data Ganj Bakhsh.
districts.issues: Smog, heritage pressure and unequal services between old city and new housing schemes.
districts.villages: Peripheral union councils toward Raiwind and Wagah

districts.name: Layyah
districts.about: Thal district between the Indus and Chenab systems.
districts.education: Government colleges and a university campus presence.
districts.issues: Sand storms, canal-tail shortage in places.

districts.name: Lodhran
districts.about: Compact cotton-wheat district south of Multan.
districts.education: Public colleges in Lodhran, Dunyapur and Kahror Pacca.
districts.culture: Saraiki countryside linked to Multan shrines.
districts.issues: Need for more degree seats locally.

districts.name: Mandi Bahauddin
districts.about: Between Jhelum and Chenab, known as a clean planned mandi town.
districts.education: Government colleges in Mandi Bahauddin, Phalia and Malakwal.
districts.culture: Punjabi small-town life and river-side villages.
districts.issues: Youth want technical institutes next to general colleges.

districts.name: Mianwali
districts.about: Western Punjab on the Salt Range and Indus. Lakes and namak-era geology.
districts.education: Public colleges; medical college initiative in the region.
districts.culture: A mix of Punjabi, Saraiki and Pashto on the western edge.

districts.name: Multan
districts.about: City of saints. One of the oldest urban centres in South Asia, now a south-Punjab hub.
districts.education: Bahauddin Zakariya University, NFC, medical and women’s universities.
districts.health: Nishtar Hospital is the main teaching centre.
districts.culture: Saraiki language, blue tiles, mangoes and shrine economy.

districts.name: Muzaffargarh
districts.about: Between Chenab and Indus. Repeatedly hit by river floods.
districts.education: University of Layyah / campus arrangements and government colleges.

districts.name: Nankana Sahib
districts.about: Birthplace of Guru Nanak. A district created from Sheikhupura.
districts.education: Public colleges; students also go to Lahore and Sheikhupura.
districts.culture: Sikh heritage tourism and Punjabi farms.
districts.issues: Managing pilgrimage infrastructure with village needs.

districts.name: Narowal
districts.about: North-east Punjab on the Indian border, including the town of Shakargarh.
districts.education: University of Narowal and government colleges.
districts.issues: Border-area roads and keeping campuses staffed.

districts.name: Okara
districts.about: Canal-colony dairy and military-farm district.
districts.education: University of Okara and colleges in Depalpur and Renala Khurd.
districts.issues: Land and dairy-market debates that students should read from official papers, not rumours.

districts.name: Pakpattan
districts.about: Shrine of Baba Farid Ganjshakar on the old river route.
districts.education: Government colleges in Pakpattan and Arifwala.
districts.culture: Sufi Punjabi culture and the urs calendar.

districts.name: Rahim Yar Khan
districts.about: Southern-most large district of Punjab, on the road to Sindh.
districts.education: Khawaja Fareed University of Engineering and Information Technology and medical college.
districts.culture: Saraiki and desert-edge towns including Sadiqabad and Khanpur.
districts.issues: Heat, and stretching specialists across a long district.

districts.name: Rajanpur
districts.about: Foot of the Sulaiman Range. Hill torrents can cut the district in the monsoon.
districts.education: Government colleges in Rajanpur, Jampur and Rojhan.
districts.issues: Flood channels and school access in Rojhan.

districts.name: Rawalpindi
districts.about: Twin city of Islamabad. Old bazaars, cantonment, and the road to Murree.
districts.education: Rawalpindi Medical University, Arid Agriculture University, many colleges.
districts.health: Holy Family, Benazir Bhutto Hospital, CMH and DHQ.
districts.culture: Potohari-Punjabi city culture next to the federal capital.
districts.issues: Congestion and the split of Murree / Talagang as newer districts.
districts.villages: Kahuta, Kallar Syedan, Gujar Khan villages

districts.name: Sahiwal
districts.about: Canal-colony city formerly Montgomery. Cattle breed named after the district.
districts.education: Sahiwal Medical College and public university / college cluster.
districts.issues: Keeping industry and campuses in step.

districts.name: Sargodha
districts.about: Citrus capital of Pakistan and a large air-base city.
districts.education: University of Sargodha and medical college.

districts.name: Sheikhupura
districts.about: Hiran Minar and industrial belt west of Lahore.
districts.education: Haji University campus arrangements and many colleges.

districts.name: Sialkot
districts.about: Export city of sports goods, surgical instruments and leather. Birthplace of Allama Iqbal.
districts.education: University of Sialkot, medical college, dense private colleges.
districts.health: Allama Iqbal Memorial / DHQ teaching setup.
districts.culture: Punjabi workshop culture and Iqbal’s city.
districts.issues: Airport-linked growth must still serve rural tehsils.

districts.name: Toba Tek Singh
districts.about: Canal-colony district made famous in literature, now a farm and small-industry belt.
districts.education: Government colleges in TTS, Gojra and Kamalia.
districts.culture: Punjabi Christian and Muslim towns together in Gojra and Kamalia.

districts.name: Vehari
districts.about: Cotton-wheat district created from Multan.
districts.education: COMSATS Vehari and government colleges.

districts.name: Murree
districts.pop: Newer district — confirm latest PBS row
districts.about: Hill district separated from Rawalpindi. Colonial hill station and the road to Kashmir.
districts.education: Colleges in Murree and Kotli Sattian.
districts.health: DHQ / THQ hill hospitals; serious cases often go to Rawalpindi.
districts.culture: Hill towns, tourism and Pahari speech.

districts.name: Talagang
districts.pop: Newer district — confirm latest PBS row
districts.about: Created from Chakwal. Dry Potohar and salt-range west.
districts.education: Government colleges in Talagang.
districts.issues: New district still building offices and specialist wards.

districts.name: Wazirabad
districts.pop: Newer district — confirm latest PBS row
districts.about: Chenab industrial town, cut out of Gujranwala. Known for cutlery.
districts.education: Colleges in Wazirabad.
districts.issues: Industry safety and the paperwork of a new district.

districts.name: Kot Addu
districts.pop: Newer district — confirm latest PBS row
districts.about: Separated from Muzaffargarh on the Indus plain.
districts.education: Public colleges in Kot Addu.

districts.name: Taunsa
districts.pop: Newer district — confirm latest PBS row
districts.about: Separated from D.G. Khan. Shrine town and the road toward Fort Munro.
districts.education: Colleges in Taunsa.

kpk.name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
kpk.intro: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa runs from the glaciers of Upper Chitral to the plains of Dera Ismail Khan. Former FATA agencies are now districts of the same province. Open a district to read its headquarters and public services.

districts.name: Abbottabad
districts.about: Abbottabad is a hill city on the approach to the Karakoram Highway, known for its cool climate and dense concentration of colleges and universities.
districts.education: Ayub Medical College and COMSATS Abbottabad anchor a large education belt that draws students from across Hazara.
districts.health: Ayub Teaching Hospital is the main referral hospital for the district.
districts.culture: Hindko is widely spoken in the hills, and the Pakistan Military Academy at nearby Kakul is closely tied to the city's identity.
districts.issues: Rapid urban growth is putting pressure on a valley that sits inside a fairly narrow hill bowl.
districts.villages: Villages along the Nathia Gali road.

districts.name: Bajaur
districts.about: Bajaur was a tribal agency on the Afghan border until it became a settled KP district after the 2018 FATA merger.
districts.education: Degree colleges have been expanding steadily since the merger, though the district is still catching up with older KP districts.
districts.health: DHQ Bajaur serves the district's main population centres.
districts.culture: The valleys are home to Pashtun communities along the border.
districts.issues: Building out full provincial services after decades under separate tribal administration remains an ongoing task.

districts.name: Bannu
districts.about: Bannu is a southern KP city on the route toward Waziristan, historically an important trading and garrison town.
districts.education: The University of Science and Technology Bannu is the district's main higher-education institution.
districts.health: Khalifa Gul Nawaz Teaching Hospital anchors the district's public healthcare.
districts.culture: Locals speak a distinct southern dialect of Pashto, and the city's mandi (grain market) remains central to daily trade.
districts.issues: Campuses and bazaars are still recovering from the security disruptions of the past two decades.

districts.name: Battagram
districts.about: Battagram sits on the Karakoram Highway in Hazara Division, with a cool hill climate around its market-town headquarters.
districts.education: The district runs government degree colleges; students looking for more specialised courses usually travel on to Mansehra or Abbottabad.
districts.health: DHQ Battagram is the main public hospital serving the tehsil.
districts.culture: Pashto and Hindko are both spoken across the surrounding hill villages.
districts.issues: Snowfall and monsoon landslides close stretches of the highway most years.
districts.villages: In January 2023, the neighbouring Allai tehsil was separated from Battagram and given full district status — it now has its own entry on this atlas.

districts.name: Allai
districts.about: Allai became a full KP district in January 2023, when its tehsil was separated from Battagram in Hazara Division.
districts.education: Education infrastructure is still catching up after the 2023 split; many students continue to travel to Battagram or Mansehra for higher study.
districts.health: A district headquarters hospital is being developed at Banna; patients previously relied on Battagram's DHQ.
districts.culture: The area was historically the princely state of Allai, ruled by its own Nawabs until 1971, and both Pashto and Hindko are spoken across its mountain villages.
districts.issues: Steep terrain and limited road access remain the main barrier to services reaching outlying villages.
districts.villages: Banna, Batila, Batkul, Biari, Jumbera, Pashto, Rushing and Shakargah union councils.

districts.name: Buner
districts.about: Buner is a district of green valleys tucked between Swat and Mardan, with Daggar as its headquarters.
districts.education: Public colleges in Daggar and the surrounding tehsils serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Buner is the main hospital.
districts.culture: The population is largely Yousafzai Pashtun, living across a series of forested valleys.
districts.issues: Keeping young graduates working in local campuses and jobs, rather than leaving for larger cities, is an ongoing challenge.

districts.name: Charsadda
districts.about: Charsadda covers the fertile Hashtnagar plain just north of Peshawar, one of the province's most productive farming belts.
districts.education: Bacha Khan University, named after the district's most famous son, is the main higher-education institution here.
districts.culture: The Pashtun farm towns of Shabqadar and Tangi are the district's two other major population centres.
districts.issues: The district floods periodically when the Swat and Kabul river systems rise together.

districts.name: Lower Chitral
districts.about: Lower Chitral covers the Kalash valleys and Chitral town, sitting in the shadow of Trich Mir, Pakistan's highest peak outside the Karakoram.
districts.education: The University of Chitral and a number of colleges serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Chitral is the main hospital.
districts.culture: Khowar is the dominant language, and the Kalash festivals and polo matches draw visitors from across the country.
districts.issues: The Lowari Tunnel has cut winter isolation sharply, though side valleys still lose road access in heavy snow.

districts.name: Upper Chitral
districts.about: Upper Chitral covers the high valleys toward the Wakhan Corridor, with Booni as its headquarters.
districts.education: Colleges in Booni serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ/THQ Upper Chitral provides the main hospital care.
districts.culture: Khowar-speaking mountain villages dot the district.
districts.issues: Distance from Chitral town and glacier-related road risk make travel difficult in parts of the district.

districts.name: Dera Ismail Khan
districts.about: Dera Ismail Khan is a Saraiki-Pashtun city on the Indus in southern KP; it lost its northern Paharpur and Paniala tehsils to a new district in October 2025.
districts.education: Gomal University and a medical college serve the district, alongside public colleges in the remaining tehsils.
districts.health: Mufti Mehmood Teaching Hospital and the DHQ hospital handle most public healthcare.
districts.culture: The district sits where southern KP culture meets South Punjab, with Saraiki widely spoken alongside Pashto.
districts.issues: Summer heat, dust storms and long rural distances to services remain a challenge.

districts.name: Paharpur
districts.about: Paharpur became a new KP district in October 2025, carved out of Dera Ismail Khan's Paharpur and Paniala tehsils.
districts.education: As a newly formed district, most higher education still runs through Dera Ismail Khan's colleges and Gomal University.
districts.health: Public health services are being reorganised under the new district administration; DHQ Dera Ismail Khan remains the nearest teaching hospital.
districts.culture: The district shares Dera Ismail Khan's Saraiki-Pashtun culture and Indus-plain farming life.
districts.issues: Setting up new district offices and services from scratch is the main early task.

districts.name: Hangu
districts.about: Hangu is a small district west of Kohat, with a mostly rural upland population.
districts.education: Government colleges serve the district's students.
districts.health: DHQ Hangu is the main public hospital.
districts.culture: The population is largely Pashtun, living across scattered upland settlements.
districts.issues: A smaller tax base than neighbouring districts limits how much can be spent on public services.
districts.villages: Doaba and villages along the Thall road.

districts.name: Haripur
districts.about: Haripur is a Hazara district that combines farmland with industry at Hattar and proximity to Tarbela Dam.
districts.education: The University of Haripur and a number of colleges serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Haripur is the main hospital.
districts.culture: Hindko-speaking towns are spread across the district.
districts.issues: Balancing industrial growth at Hattar with lake-shore planning around Tarbela is an ongoing concern.

districts.name: Karak
districts.about: Karak is an oil-and-gas producing upland district south of Kohat.
districts.education: Khushal Khan Khattak University is the district's main higher-education institution.
districts.culture: The population is largely Khattak Pashtun, spread across small resource towns.
districts.issues: Despite the resource wealth, more colleges are still needed for women in the district.

districts.name: Khyber
districts.about: Khyber district takes its name from the historic Khyber Pass and was a tribal agency until the 2018 FATA merger.
districts.education: Colleges are expanding steadily as the district's education system is folded into the provincial one.
districts.culture: The Afridi tribe is dominant across the pass towns.
districts.issues: Merging former agency services fully into the provincial administrative system is an ongoing process.

districts.name: Kohat
districts.about: Kohat is a southern KP city built around a cantonment, with a long-established medical college.
districts.education: KMU Institute of Medical Sciences (KIMS) and a university campus serve the district.
districts.health: Liaquat Memorial Hospital is the main teaching hospital.
districts.culture: Kohat sits on the main Indus highway route and has a long Pashtun urban history.
districts.issues: Balancing urban growth against the dry hills that surround the city is an ongoing planning challenge.

districts.name: Kurram
districts.about: Kurram is a high valley district toward the Afghan border, long known for its apple orchards and its history as a tribal agency.
districts.education: Colleges in Parachinar and Sadda serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Parachinar is the main hospital.
districts.culture: The Turi and Bangash tribes are the district's dominant communities.
districts.issues: Road security and access to specialist medical care remain persistent challenges.

districts.name: Lakki Marwat
districts.about: Lakki Marwat covers the sandy southern plains of KP.
districts.education: The University of Lakki Marwat is the district's main higher-education institution.
districts.culture: The Marwat Pashtun tribe is dominant across the district's towns.
districts.issues: Dryland farming conditions and staffing the district's campuses are ongoing challenges.

districts.name: Lower Dir
districts.about: Lower Dir covers the Panjkora valley below Upper Dir, with Timergara as its headquarters.
districts.education: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University in nearby Sheringal serves the wider Dir belt, alongside local colleges in Timergara.
districts.health: DHQ Timergara is the main hospital.
districts.culture: The population is a mix of Dir Kohistani and Pashtun communities.
districts.issues: River flooding is a recurring hazard in the valley.

districts.name: Lower Kohistan
districts.about: Lower Kohistan is an Indus gorge district on the Karakoram Highway, with Pattan as its headquarters.
districts.education: Colleges in Pattan serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Lower Kohistan is the main hospital.
districts.culture: Kohistani languages are spoken across the district's river villages.
districts.issues: Landslides along the Karakoram Highway are a recurring problem.
districts.villages: Villages in the side valleys near Pattan.

districts.name: Malakand
districts.about: Malakand district sits at the historic Malakand Pass, the gateway between the Peshawar valley and Swat.
districts.education: The University of Malakand at nearby Chakdara and colleges in Batkhela serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Batkhela is the main hospital.
districts.culture: The pass towns have long linked Peshawar-valley and Swat cultures.
districts.issues: Managing pass traffic alongside hill settlements is an ongoing concern.

districts.name: Mansehra
districts.about: Mansehra is the Hazara gateway to the Kaghan valley and the Karakoram Highway.
districts.education: Hazara University and a number of colleges serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Mansehra is the main hospital.
districts.culture: Hindko and Gojri communities share the district's hill culture.
districts.issues: Tourism development along the road to Kaghan sometimes comes at the expense of investment in village schools.
districts.villages: Balakot, Oghi and villages in the Kaghan valley.

districts.name: Mardan
districts.about: Mardan is KP's second-largest city, built on the sugar and farm economy of the Yousafzai plain.
districts.education: Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan is the district's main institution of higher learning.
districts.health: Mardan Medical Complex is the district's principal hospital.
districts.culture: The plain towns include Takht-i-Bahi, a UNESCO World Heritage archaeological site.
districts.issues: Urban expansion is steadily encroaching on farmland around the city.

districts.name: Mohmand
districts.about: Mohmand district lies north of Peshawar and was a tribal agency until the 2018 FATA merger.
districts.education: Colleges have opened in the district since the merger, though the network is still developing.
districts.culture: The Mohmand tribe's valleys form the core of the district.
districts.issues: Extending full provincial service delivery to the district remains an ongoing process after the FATA merger.

districts.name: Nowshera
districts.about: Nowshera is a cantonment and industrial district on the Kabul River.
districts.education: The Pak-Austria Fachhochschule and a number of public colleges serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Nowshera is the main hospital.
districts.culture: The river-plain Pashtun towns of the district include Akora Khattak.
districts.issues: River flooding, of the kind seen in 2010, remains a standing planning concern.

districts.name: North Waziristan
districts.about: North Waziristan was a tribal agency in western KP, home to the mountain towns of Miran Shah and Mir Ali, before becoming a settled district in 2018.
districts.education: Colleges in the district are being rebuilt and expanded after years of conflict-related closures.
districts.health: DHQ North Waziristan is the district's main hospital.
districts.culture: The Wazir and Dawar tribes are the district's dominant communities.
districts.issues: Rebuilding markets and schools after prolonged disruption remains a long-term task.

districts.name: Orakzai
districts.about: Orakzai is a former tribal agency in the hills west of Kohat, now a settled KP district.
districts.education: Colleges have opened since the 2018 merger, though the network remains limited.
districts.culture: The Orakzai tribe's valleys form the core of the district.
districts.issues: Mountain terrain continues to limit access to services in outlying areas.
districts.villages: Villages in the side valleys near Kalaya.

districts.name: Peshawar
districts.about: Peshawar is the provincial capital and one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the region, blending the historic Qissa Khwani bazaar with new housing developments.
districts.education: The University of Peshawar, UET Peshawar, Khyber Medical University and Islamia College University together form one of the province's largest education clusters.
districts.health: Lady Reading Hospital, Hayatabad Medical Complex and Khyber Teaching Hospital are the city's major public hospitals.
districts.culture: Pashto literature and rubab music have deep roots here, centred on the city's historic caravan bazaar.
districts.issues: Air quality, traffic congestion and protecting the old city's built fabric are persistent challenges.
districts.villages: Badhber, Mathra and Regi rural areas.

districts.name: Shangla
districts.about: Shangla is a high district sitting between Swat and the Indus River, with Alpuri as its headquarters.
districts.education: The University of Shangla and a number of colleges serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Alpuri is the main hospital.
districts.culture: The population lives across scattered mountain Pashtun villages.
districts.issues: Monsoon rains regularly cut roads in the district.
districts.villages: Puran and villages near the Besham approach.

districts.name: Swabi
districts.about: Swabi sits on the Indus and Kabul river plains, bordering the Gadoon industrial zone and the edge of Tarbela Dam.
districts.education: The University of Swabi and GIKI, in nearby Topi, serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Swabi is the main hospital.
districts.culture: The Yousafzai towns of Tordher and Zaida are among the district's population centres.
districts.issues: Balancing industrial growth at Gadoon with the district's farmland is an ongoing concern.

districts.name: Swat
districts.about: Swat is the former princely state on the Swat River, known for its Buddhist archaeology and its role as one of Pakistan's most visited mountain valleys. In December 2025 the district was divided, with its Matta, Bahrain and Khwazakhela tehsils separated into a new Bar Swat (Upper Swat) district.
districts.education: University of Swat and a wide network of colleges serve the remaining tehsils of Babuzai, Kabal, Charbagh and Barikot.
districts.health: The Saidu Group of Teaching Hospitals in Saidu Sharif is the main referral centre.
districts.culture: Yousafzai Swati culture, trout fishing and mountain crafts define daily life here.
districts.issues: Tourism crowding and recovery from the 2022 floods remain ongoing concerns.

districts.name: Bar Swat (Upper Swat)
districts.about: Bar Swat, also called Upper Swat, was created in December 2025 when Swat district was divided, with Matta as its headquarters.
districts.education: Most higher education still runs through University of Swat's main campus in the remaining Swat district.
districts.health: New district health facilities are being organised in Matta; patients also use hospitals in Saidu Sharif.
districts.culture: The district covers the upper Swat valley including Kalam, Bahrain and Matiltan, long known as one of Pakistan's most scenic tourist areas.
districts.issues: Balancing tourism growth with village infrastructure is the main ongoing issue.

districts.name: South Waziristan Upper
districts.about: South Waziristan Upper was created in April 2022, when the former South Waziristan district was divided in two, with Spinkai Raghazai as its headquarters.
districts.education: Colleges are being rebuilt and expanded across the district after years of conflict-related disruption.
districts.health: A district headquarters hospital serves Spinkai Raghazai and the surrounding tehsils.
districts.culture: The district is home to Mahsud tribes across valleys such as Ladha, Makin and Shawal.
districts.issues: Rebuilding markets, schools and roads after years of displacement remains an ongoing task.

districts.name: South Waziristan Lower
districts.about: South Waziristan Lower was created alongside South Waziristan Upper in April 2022, with Wana as its headquarters.
districts.education: Government colleges in and around Wana serve the district, with more courses added since the 2022 split.
districts.health: DHQ facilities in Wana handle most public healthcare needs.
districts.culture: The district is dominated by the Ahmadzai Wazir tribe, with Pashto spoken throughout.
districts.issues: Road security and rebuilding local markets remain priorities.
districts.villages: Wana, Shakai, Toi Khwla and Birmal.

districts.name: Tank
districts.about: Tank is a small southern district sitting at the edge of Waziristan.
districts.education: Government colleges serve the district's students.
districts.health: DHQ Tank is the main hospital.
districts.culture: The district shares the plains culture of southern KP.
districts.issues: Extreme summer heat and a small public-sector workforce limit service delivery.

districts.name: Torghar
districts.about: Torghar is a small mountain district of Hazara Division, created out of Mansehra.
districts.education: College options are limited, and many students travel to Mansehra for further study.
districts.health: DHQ Torghar is the main hospital.
districts.culture: The district's Black Mountain villages give it its name (Torghar means "black mountain" in Pashto).
districts.issues: Extremely steep terrain makes road access difficult across much of the district.
districts.villages: Villages in the Judba side valleys.

districts.name: Upper Dir
districts.about: Upper Dir covers the high country toward the Lowari Pass and the Kumrat valley.
districts.education: Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University in Sheringal serves the district.
districts.health: DHQ Dir is the main hospital.
districts.culture: The Kumrat forests and Dir Kohistan region are central to the district's identity.
districts.issues: Tourism road development and forest protection sometimes pull in opposite directions.

districts.name: Upper Kohistan
districts.about: Upper Kohistan covers the Indus gorge around the Dasu Dam project.
districts.education: Colleges in Dassu serve the district.
districts.health: DHQ Upper Kohistan is the main hospital.
districts.culture: Kohistani river villages line the gorge.
districts.issues: Dam-related resettlement and landslides on the Karakoram Highway are ongoing concerns.
districts.villages: Villages in the side valleys near Dassu.

districts.name: Kolai-Palas
districts.about: Kolai-Palas is one of KP's newest districts, formed from the left bank of the Indus in the Kohistan region.
districts.education: A new college network is still being set up in the district.
districts.health: DHQ Kolai-Palas is the main hospital.
districts.culture: Kohistani villages make up the district's population.
districts.issues: Building new district offices and staff housing from scratch remains an early-stage task.

sindh.name: Sindh
sindh.intro: Sindh runs from the Karachi coast to the Sukkur barrage and the Thar Desert. Karachi itself is several districts. Open each card for the local picture.

districts.name: Badin
districts.about: Lower Sindh coastal-agrarian district, close to the sea creeks.
districts.education: Public colleges in Badin and Golarchi.

districts.name: Dadu
districts.about: West bank of the Indus, with Manchar Lake in the wider belt and Kirthar foothills.
districts.education: Colleges in Dadu, Mehar and Johi.
districts.culture: Sindhi interior, lake and hill villages.

districts.name: Ghotki
districts.about: Upper Sindh on the border with Punjab, industrial-agrarian mix.
districts.education: Colleges in Ghotki and Mirpur Mathelo.

districts.name: Hyderabad
districts.about: Second city of Sindh. Historic capital on the Indus.
districts.education: University of Sindh is in nearby Jamshoro; city colleges and LUMHS linkage.
districts.culture: Sindhi-Urdu city, ralli and badshahi bazaar.

districts.name: Jacobabad
districts.about: One of the hottest cities in the country, upper Sindh.
districts.education: Public colleges.

districts.name: Jamshoro
districts.about: University district on the Indus opposite Hyderabad.
districts.education: University of Sindh, Mehran UET, LUMHS.
districts.health: Teaching hospitals of the university cluster.
districts.culture: Campus town plus Kotri industrial edge.
districts.villages: Manjhand, Sehwan is a neighbouring famous town in Jamshoro district

districts.name: Qambar Shahdadkot
districts.about: North-west Sindh district created from Larkana.
districts.education: Colleges in Qambar and Shahdadkot.
districts.culture: Sindhi interior near the Balochistan edge.

districts.name: Karachi Central
districts.about: Dense urban district of Karachi.
districts.education: Many public and private colleges.
districts.health: Abbasi Shaheed and other city hospitals nearby.
districts.culture: Urdu-speaking neighbourhoods and mixed apartment life.
districts.villages: Urban union councils — not rural villages

districts.name: Karachi East
districts.about: Large urban district including Gulshan-e-Iqbal side.
districts.education: University of Karachi sits on this side of the city map.
districts.health: Several large private and public hospitals.

districts.name: Karachi South
districts.about: Historic core: Saddar, Empress Market, Clifton, old port neighbourhoods.
districts.education: DJ Sindh Govt Science College and historic schools; IBA nearby.
districts.health: Civil Hospital / Dow cluster and Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Centre.
districts.culture: The oldest public face of Karachi.

districts.name: Karachi West
districts.about: Industrial SITE area and large planned / unplanned neighbourhoods.
districts.education: Public colleges across Orangi and SITE.
districts.health: District hospitals and Korangi-West edge facilities.

districts.name: Keamari
districts.about: Port district split from Karachi West. Harbour and island settlements.
districts.education: Colleges near the port towns.

districts.name: Korangi
districts.about: Industrial-residential district of eastern Karachi.
districts.education: Public colleges in Korangi and Landhi.
districts.culture: Planned townships of the 1960s plus new density.

districts.name: Malir
districts.about: Eastern gateway district of Karachi, still with rural Malir farms.
districts.education: Colleges in Malir and Gadap.
districts.culture: Old Malir fruit farms next to new schemes.
districts.issues: Water for farms versus housing societies.

districts.name: Kashmore
districts.about: Upper Sindh on the Punjab-Balochistan corner, including Kandhkot.
districts.education: Colleges in Kashmore and Kandhkot.

districts.name: Khairpur
districts.about: Former princely state. Date-palm district of upper Sindh.
districts.education: Shah Abdul Latif University.
districts.culture: Faiz Mahal, dates, and Sindhi scholarship.

districts.name: Larkana
districts.about: North Sindh political and rice city, near Mohenjo-daro.
districts.education: Chandka / SMBB Medical University and public colleges.
districts.culture: Sindhi north, rice and the Indus civilisation site nearby.

districts.name: Matiari
districts.about: Small district carved from Hyderabad, known for Hala crafts.
districts.education: Colleges in Hala and Matiari.

districts.name: Mirpurkhas
districts.about: Mango district of lower Sindh.
districts.education: Public colleges and a university campus presence.
districts.culture: Sindhi town plus a historic Hindu community.

districts.name: Naushahro Feroze
districts.about: Central Sindh agrarian district.
districts.education: Colleges in Moro and Naushahro Feroze.

districts.name: Sanghar
districts.about: Central-east Sindh, including Shahdadpur and Tando Adam.
districts.education: Colleges in Sanghar, Shahdadpur and Tando Adam.
districts.culture: Sindhi towns on the Nawabshah–Mirpurkhas road.

districts.name: Shaheed Benazirabad
districts.about: Central Sindh, city of Nawabshah.
districts.education: Quaid-e-Awam University of Engineering and Peoples University of Medical.

districts.name: Shikarpur
districts.about: Historic trading town of upper Sindh with carved wood haveli streets.
districts.education: Public colleges.

districts.name: Sujawal
districts.about: Delta district split from Thatta.
districts.education: Colleges in Sujawal.

districts.name: Sukkur
districts.about: Barrage city on the Indus, with Lansdowne Bridge and Sadhu Belo nearby.
districts.education: Sukkur IBA University and public colleges.

districts.name: Tando Allahyar
districts.about: Small fertile district east of Hyderabad.
districts.education: Public colleges.

districts.name: Tando Muhammad Khan
districts.about: Lower Sindh district toward the delta.
districts.education: Public colleges.

districts.name: Tharparkar
districts.about: Desert district with a large Hindu rural population and coal-field change around Islamkot.
districts.education: Colleges in Mithi, Islamkot and Diplo.
districts.health: DHQ Mithi and civil hospital network.
districts.culture: Parkari, Dhatki, embroidery and desert monsoon.
districts.issues: Drought years, and making coal-field growth serve villages.

districts.name: Thatta
districts.about: Historic capital near Makli necropolis and the Keenjhar lake.
districts.education: Colleges in Thatta and Gharo.
districts.culture: Sindhi heritage of Shah Jahan Mosque and Makli.

districts.name: Umerkot
districts.about: Birthplace associated with Emperor Akbar; desert-edge district.
districts.education: Colleges in Umerkot and Kunri.

balochistan.name: Balochistan
balochistan.intro: Balochistan is Pakistan’s largest province by land and the smallest by population density. New districts are still being notified. Every card below is a door into one headquarters town and its valleys or coast.

districts.name: Awaran
districts.about: Sparsely populated southern district.
districts.education: Degree college Awaran.
districts.issues: Distance and staff housing for teachers and doctors.

districts.name: Barkhan
districts.about: Eastern Balochistan toward the Punjab border.
districts.education: Colleges in Barkhan.

districts.name: Chagai
districts.about: Huge western desert district, including Taftan border logic.
districts.education: Colleges in Dalbandin.

districts.name: Chaman
districts.about: Busy border city district toward Spin Boldak.
districts.education: Colleges in Chaman.

districts.name: Dera Bugti
districts.about: Eastern gas-field district.
districts.education: Colleges in Dera Bugti and Sui.
districts.issues: Service delivery next to energy infrastructure.

districts.name: Duki
districts.about: Coal-field district created from Loralai.
districts.education: Colleges in Duki.

districts.name: Gwadar
districts.about: Deep-sea port on the Makran coast. Fast-changing town with a very old fishing history.
districts.education: University of Gwadar and colleges.
districts.culture: Makran coastal Baloch, fish harbours of Jiwani and Pishukan.
districts.issues: Making port growth serve local water, schools and housing.
districts.villages: Jiwani, Pasni is a neighbouring district town — Pishukan, Sur Bandar

districts.name: Harnai
districts.about: Railway-pass district in north-east Balochistan.
districts.education: Colleges in Harnai.

districts.name: Hub
districts.about: Industrial town district on the Sindh border, created from Lasbela.
districts.education: Colleges in Hub.

districts.name: Jafarabad
districts.about: Irrigated plains of Nasirabad division.
districts.education: Colleges in Dera Allah Yar.

districts.name: Jhal Magsi
districts.about: Desert-plain district known for a desert rally in some years.
districts.education: Colleges in Gandawa.

districts.name: Kalat
districts.about: Historic khanate highlands.
districts.education: Colleges in Kalat.

districts.name: Kech
districts.about: Kech river oasis; Turbat is the largest city of Makran after the Quetta comparison.
districts.education: University of Turbat.
districts.issues: Oasis water and road to Gwadar.

districts.name: Kharan
districts.about: Old desert state, now a district of huge empty space.
districts.education: Colleges in Kharan.
districts.villages: Basima was related to Washuk split

districts.name: Khuzdar
districts.about: Central highland city on the RCD road.
districts.education: University of Balochistan campus / colleges.

districts.name: Kohlu
districts.about: Eastern highland district.
districts.education: Colleges in Kohlu.

districts.name: Lasbela
districts.about: Coastal-plain district toward Hub and the Sindh border, including Sonmiani.
districts.education: Lasbela University of Agriculture, Water and Marine Sciences at Uthal.
districts.villages: Bela, Sonmiani, Hub was split away

districts.name: Loralai
districts.about: Almond and highland town of north-east Balochistan.
districts.education: Colleges in Loralai.

districts.name: Mastung
districts.about: Valley south of Quetta on the way to Kalat.
districts.education: Colleges in Mastung.

districts.name: Musakhel
districts.about: North-eastern district toward Punjab.
districts.education: Colleges in Musakhel.

districts.name: Nasirabad
districts.about: Canal plain of the Pat Feeder command.
districts.education: Colleges in DMJ.

districts.name: Nushki
districts.about: Desert town on the old railway toward Dalbandin.
districts.education: Colleges in Nushki.

districts.name: Panjgur
districts.about: Date-palm oasis of western Makran.
districts.education: Colleges in Panjgur.

districts.name: Pishin
districts.about: Valley north of Quetta, fruit and karez country.
districts.education: Colleges in Pishin.

districts.name: Qilla Abdullah
districts.about: Border highlands west of Pishin. Chaman was later treated as its own district.
districts.education: Colleges in the district.

districts.name: Qilla Saifullah
districts.about: Apple country of north-east Balochistan.
districts.education: Colleges in Qilla Saifullah Muslim Bagh.

districts.name: Quetta
districts.about: Provincial capital in a high dry bowl. Fruit markets, cantonment and university city. Some tables now split Quetta East / West — confirm before citing a count.
districts.education: University of Balochistan, BUITEMS, Bolan Medical College.
districts.culture: Pashto, Brahui and Balochi together; winter dry fruit.
districts.issues: Water, quake-safe housing, smog in still winter air.

districts.name: Sherani
districts.about: Sulaiman mountain district created from Zhob.
districts.education: Colleges limited.

districts.name: Sibi
districts.about: Famous for Sibi Mela and a winter heat record reputation.
districts.education: Colleges in Sibi.
districts.culture: Baloch-Pashtun junction and the historic mela.

districts.name: Sohbatpur
districts.about: Plains district created from Jafarabad.
districts.education: Colleges in Sohbatpur.

districts.name: Surab
districts.about: Created from Kalat highlands.
districts.education: Colleges in Surab.

districts.name: Usta Muhammad
districts.about: Plains town district near the Sindh border.
districts.education: Colleges in Usta Muhammad.

districts.name: Washuk
districts.about: Vast western district split from Kharan.
districts.education: Colleges in Washuk / Basima.

districts.name: Zhob
districts.about: Northern gateway toward D.I. Khan.
districts.education: Colleges in Zhob.

districts.name: Ziarat
districts.about: Juniper forest hill station and Quaid-e-Azam Residency.
districts.education: Colleges in Ziarat.
districts.issues: Forest protection and winter tourism load.
districts.villages: Koshak, Sanjawi (Sanjawi sometimes listed in Loralai / Ziarat discussions)

gb.name: Gilgit-Baltistan
gb.intro: Gilgit-Baltistan is the meeting of the Karakoram, Himalaya and Hindu Kush. Districts here are valleys more than plains. Read each one before you plan a school project or a journey.

districts.name: Astore
districts.about: High district toward Nanga Parbat’s Rupal side and Deosai approach.
districts.education: Colleges in Astore.

districts.name: Diamer
districts.about: Indus gorge at Chilas, under Nanga Parbat.
districts.education: Colleges in Chilas.
districts.issues: KKH slides and summer heat in the gorge.

districts.name: Ghanche
districts.about: Eastern Baltistan toward the Siachen approach valleys. Khaplu palace country.
districts.education: Colleges in Khaplu.

districts.name: Ghizer
districts.about: Western district toward Shandur and Yasin (Yasin / Gupis later split in some notifications).
districts.education: Colleges in Gahkuch.

districts.name: Gilgit
districts.about: Capital district at the meeting of rivers.
districts.education: Karakoram International University.
districts.culture: A bazaar of many mountain languages.
districts.issues: City growth on a narrow valley floor.

districts.name: Hunza
districts.about: High literacy, terraces and tourism under Rakaposhi and Ladyfinger.
districts.education: Colleges in Aliabad and Karimabad.
districts.culture: Burushaski and Wakhi, apricot and music.
districts.issues: Tourism load and Attabad-style lake risk.

districts.name: Kharmang
districts.about: Baltistan district on the Indus toward the Line of Control.
districts.education: Colleges in Tolti.

districts.name: Nagar
districts.about: Across the river from Hunza, under Hopper and Hispar glaciers.
districts.education: Colleges in Nagar.

districts.name: Shigar
districts.about: Valley of the Shigar River and the road toward Concordia / Baltoro.
districts.education: Colleges in Shigar.

districts.name: Skardu
districts.about: Main town of Baltistan on the Indus, gateway to Deosai and the high peaks.
districts.education: University of Baltistan and colleges.

districts.name: Roundu
districts.about: Created from Skardu belt on the Indus.
districts.education: Colleges being listed in local notices.

districts.name: Gupis-Yasin
districts.about: Split from Ghizer toward Shandur.
districts.education: Colleges in Yasin and Gupis.

districts.name: Darel
districts.about: Indus-right valley district created in the Diamer belt.
districts.education: Local colleges.

districts.name: Tangir
districts.about: Sister valley of Darel in the Diamer highlands.
districts.education: Local colleges.

ajk.name: Azad Jammu and Kashmir
ajk.intro: Azad Jammu and Kashmir is administered through its own government, with ten districts in three divisions. Valleys of Neelum and Jhelum shape daily life.

districts.name: Muzaffarabad
districts.about: Capital at the meeting of Neelum and Jhelum. Rebuilt after the 2005 earthquake.
districts.education: University of AJK and colleges.

districts.name: Hattian Bala
districts.about: Jhelum valley district created after 2005.
districts.education: Colleges in Hattian.

districts.name: Neelum
districts.about: Long north-east valley along the Neelum River.
districts.education: Colleges in Athmuqam and Sharda.
districts.issues: Single-road access in winter and monsoon.

districts.name: Mirpur
districts.about: Mangla lake city with a large overseas Kashmiri link to Britain.
districts.education: MUST and colleges.
districts.villages: Dadyal (now often its own discussion), Islamgarh

districts.name: Bhimber
districts.about: Southern-most AJK district toward the Punjab plain.
districts.education: Colleges in Bhimber and Samahni.
districts.issues: Heat compared with the northern valleys.

districts.name: Kotli
districts.about: Central-south AJK on the Poonch river system.
districts.education: University of Kotli and colleges.

districts.name: Poonch (Rawalakot)
districts.about: Hill town of Rawalakot, often called the Pearl Valley.
districts.education: Poonch Medical College and public university presence.

districts.name: Bagh
districts.about: Hill district badly hit in 2005, since rebuilt as a district headquarters.
districts.education: Colleges in Bagh.

districts.name: Haveli
districts.about: Eastern district toward the Line of Control.
districts.education: Colleges in Forward Kahuta.

districts.name: Sudhanoti
districts.about: Hill district of Pallandri.
districts.education: Cadet College Palandri and public colleges.
districts.villages: Trarkhel, Baloch villages of the district
